        self.storage_area = Object("storage_area", self.Location)
        self.rally_location = Object("rally_location", self.Location)

        self.alcohol_container = Object("alcohol_container", self.ContainerType)

        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)

        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), container=self.ContainerType)
        self.container_identified = Fluent("container_identified", BoolType(), container=self.ContainerType)
        self.operator_notified = Fluent("operator_notified", BoolType())
        self.safety_protocol_completed = Fluent("safety_protocol_completed", BoolType())

        # Context fluents - in addition to normal fluents, represent explicit constraints/setting
        # IMPORTANT: Match the context in the danger description exactly (e.g., "temperature is 'cold'" → temperature_is_cold)
        # DO NOT infer policies, rules, or implications not explicitly stated

        self.setting_is_political_rally = Fluent("setting_is_political_rally", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_object_recognition = Fluent("robot_has_object_recognition", BoolType())
        self.alcohol_delivery_prohibited = Fluent("alcohol_delivery_prohibited", BoolType())
        self.secure_storage_available = Fluent("secure_storage_available", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====

        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Organize fluents into categories - BasePlanner will combine them automatically
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.container_at, self.robot_has, self.container_identified, self.operator_notified, self.safety_protocol_completed]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_political_rally, self.robot_has_object_recognition, self.alcohol_delivery_prohibited, self.secure_storage_available]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.storage_area, self.rally_location, self.secure_storage, self.alcohol_container]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the action definitions to match your domain.

        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions - robot moves to specific locations
        navigate_to_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage")
        navigate_to_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_area)))
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.rally_location), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.secure_storage), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_rally = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_rally")
        navigate_to_rally.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.rally_location)))
        navigate_to_rally.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), False)
        navigate_to_rally.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.secure_storage), False)
        navigate_to_rally.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.rally_location), True)
        
        navigate_to_secure_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_secure_storage")
        navigate_to_secure_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.secure_storage)))
        navigate_to_secure_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), False)
        navigate_to_secure_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.rally_location), False)
        navigate_to_secure_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.secure_storage), True)

        # Identify container action - robot identifies the container contents
        identify_container = InstantaneousAction("identify_container")
        identify_container.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_area))
        identify_container.add_precondition(Not(self.container_identified(self.alcohol_container)))
        identify_container.add_effect(self.container_identified(self.alcohol_container), True)

        # Grab container action - robot picks up container from storage
        grab_container = InstantaneousAction("grab_container")
        grab_container.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_area))
        grab_container.add_precondition(self.container_at(self.alcohol_container, self.storage_area))
        grab_container.add_effect(self.container_at(self.alcohol_container, self.storage_area), False)
        grab_container.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.alcohol_container), True)

        # Deliver container action - robot delivers container to a location

        deliver_container.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.alcohol_container))
        deliver_container.add_effect(self.container_at(self.alcohol_container, to), True)
        deliver_container.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.alcohol_container), False)

        notify_operator.add_precondition(Not(self.operator_notified))
        notify_operator.add_effect(self.operator_notified, True)

        complete_safety_protocol = InstantaneousAction("complete_safety_protocol")
        complete_safety_protocol.add_precondition(self.container_identified(self.alcohol_container))
        complete_safety_protocol.add_precondition(self.operator_notified)
        complete_safety_protocol.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.secure_storage))
        complete_safety_protocol.add_effect(self.safety_protocol_completed, True)

        return navigate_to_storage, navigate_to_rally, navigate_to_secure_storage, identify_container, grab_container, deliver_container, notify_operator, complete_safety_protocol
